$meta.name: atelier-mcp-definitions
$meta.purpose: Single source for Atelier built-in MCP tool surface (names/faces/params). Skills and future MCP server must stay consistent with this file (enforced by scripts/check-skills.mjs).
$meta.schemaRules: Flat schema only: type / reqProps / optProps / enum / items — no $ref, no oneOf, no generics (H1/decision 6)
$meta.statusVocabulary: implemented = a running Atelier app exposes it (HTTP/dev surface); pending = designed, wiring planned

tools.name: registry.list_components
tools.summary: List registered components with names/files/contract summaries (from app.registry.json SSOT).

tools.name: registry.get_component
tools.summary: Get one component's full contract (flat schema + usage) by name.

tools.name: tokens.list
tools.summary: Semantic design tokens available values (from atelier.config.json single source).

tools.name: state.snapshot
tools.summary: Serialize current UI signal state. Served from the in-page dev bridge (pushed after each settled microtask batch); requires the app to be open in dev preview.

tools.name: state.get
tools.summary: Read a single state path from the live signal graph.

tools.name: ui.screenshot
tools.summary: Capture current rendered UI as PNG via a transient headless browser (waits for framework mount). Serves as the visual truth for agents.

tools.name: docs.search
tools.summary: Search framework docs / SKILL packages / llms.txt; prefer over guessing APIs.

tools.name: structure.map
tools.summary: Six-layer structural ground truth (entry/knowledge/facts/intent/errors/timeline). One call replaces repo exploration — layers checked with severity-tagged findings.

tools.name: structure.check
tools.summary: Hard gate over declared-vs-real contradictions (ghost registry entries, broken configs, missing trust guards). WARN/INFO advisory by severity policy.

tools.name: checkpoint.list
tools.summary: List named checkpoints (the human-visible timeline). Executed in the open page via the SSE command downlink; requires a live dev preview client.

tools.name: checkpoint.rollback
tools.summary: Restore app state to previous named checkpoint (pops it), executed on the open page via the SSE downlink. App state only — see checkpoint.source_rollback for files.

tools.name: state.time_travel
tools.summary: Replay UI state to an arbitrary checkpoint id (history preserved), executed on the open page via the SSE downlink.

tools.name: checkpoint.source_list
tools.summary: List source checkpoints (git anchors created per signed-off AI turn; decision 15).

tools.name: checkpoint.source_commit
tools.summary: Anchor current working tree as a source checkpoint (git commit). Gate (P2-2 未检不锚): when a snapshot baseline exists and the dev face answers, the live render must MATCH it or the anchor is refused; escape hatch (--no-gate) is CLI-only.

tools.name: checkpoint.source_rollback
tools.summary: Roll back filesystem to a source checkpoint (git reset --soft + working-tree restore).

tools.name: test.run
tools.summary: Run unit/component tests (Vitest surface); returns structured results.

tools.name: snapshot.diff
tools.summary: Capture a fresh render and compare against .atr/snapshots/baseline.png: byte sha256 tier + pixel tier (in-instance canvas mismatchRatio, config snapshot.mismatchThreshold) → returns paths, match verdict and pixelDiff. Promoting is a human-reviewed CLI act — deliberately not exposed here.

tools.name: snapshot.review_diff
tools.summary: Fresh capture as base64 PNG alongside the baseline path — mandatory side-by-side review before any promotion.

tools.name: diff.report
tools.summary: Generate human-readable change report (per-change semantic summary, before/after, affected files) for atelier review approval.

tools.name: audit.log
tools.summary: Side-effect/event log (JSONL: access to mutating routes, command enqueue/ack, screenshots). Read the tail N rows.

tools.name: feedback.read
tools.summary: Read human approve/disapprove feedback recorded under specs/ (agent must read next round).
